name: a-narrowed-branch

steps.command: mkdir src && echo a > src/a.py && echo b > b.py
echo A > src/a.py && echo note > note.md

steps.stdout:
view: src/
 A note.md
 M src/a.py

# what child changed since <c1>, where the two last met: what `ws-git merge child` brings
# 1 path(s) in child's seed
diff --git a/src/a.py b/src/a.py
--- a/src/a.py
+++ b/src/a.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
+A
# 1 path(s) elsewhere
diff --git a/note.md b/note.md
--- a/note.md
+++ b/note.md
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+note

steps.stderr: ws-git: sparse-checkout takes no 'set' (list is all there is): a view is given when the session is forked (ws-git branch <name> --paths <paths>) and cannot be changed here. usage: ws-git sparse-checkout [list]; see 'ws-git help'
ws-git: '/' names the whole filesystem, which is not a view — pass paths=None for the whole tree, or name the workspace root ('/workspace') to see all of it as a seed

summary: branch --paths narrows what the fork sees; it says so in status and sparse-checkout, and a diff of it groups its seed from the rest.
